base.text: Remember this day, ten cycles ago?
You crushed a mush bar out of sheer nerves.
Tonight I'll crush the stars for you.
Another year... by colony reckoning.
As long as there's oxygen, I'll keep counting with you.
Your gift: a massage table pass. Cost me three shift trades.
Mine: I rescheduled all your shifts to daytime.
...We really are perfect for each other.
A hundred cycles and you still tolerate my snoring.
Tolerate is strong. Let's say I've stopped filing reports.
Happy anniversary. Base intact, us intact.
On this planet, that's the highest score there is.
Yesterday... was our day.
I know. Dig shift. Neither of us dared bring it up.
I waited until the mess hall lights went out.
...I'm sorry. The tunnel collapsed. I couldn't get back.
You're safe. The date can wait a year.
I kept the candied berry two days. Then I ate it alone.
...Next anniversary, I'll tear up the schedule itself.
I lost my temper last time. I'm sorry.
I went too far too. Let's move on.
I should not have taken it out on you.
Breathe first next time. And yes, I forgive you.
I went too far. Here — barbeque. The real kind.
...Fine. For the barbeque's sake.
I was wrong to drag up old fights.
All dragged up now? Then come eat.
I'm sorry. Your pipework isn't that bad.
Apology accepted. Review returned to sender.
I rehearsed this apology all the way here.
Good rehearsal. Never need it again.
I yelled about the wire. It was the hunger talking.
Then eat first, apologize second. Both accepted.

gentle.text: I thought about it all night. I owe you a proper sorry.
You showing up says more than the words.
I'm sorry I left that whole mess on you alone.
It's fine. Just lend a hand next time.
What I said that day? I take it back. Gently.
Retraction accepted. The tea's still warm, sit.
I brewed two cups of berry juice. One is an apology.
A thank-you for still talking to me.

hothead.text: Yesterday... wasn't entirely my fault. Partly was. Fine. Sorry.
An apology squeezed out like toothpaste. Accepted.
I'm not here to apologize. ...Okay, I am. Sorry.
Your voice dropped an octave at the door. I knew.
SORRY! There! Loud means it counts!
It counts, it counts. Indoor volume works too.
Your pipework is... actually decent. Yesterday was on me.
I'm framing the first half and accepting the second.

base.text: About that fight... I was out of line.
We're good. Honestly, I get you better now.
I said it too harshly. Sorry.
Same here. Nothing bonds people like a good argument.
Still mad?
Nah. If we can fight like that, we must really care.
Next time I'll hear you out first.
And I'll yell less. Shake on it?
Could you stop leaving every mess for someone else?
I'm already run off my feet. What more do you want?
You scrambled the schedule again.
No, you just didn't read it!
I really cannot deal with this right now.
Fine. Then we stay out of each other's way.
You snore like an unoiled rock crusher!
Me? You recited coordinates in your sleep all night!
Where's the berry I was saving? The single berry!
It didn't have your name on it!
Can you clear that junk pile in the corridor?
Those are spare parts! Every single one is useful!
The lavatory is clogged because you crossed the pipes!
I followed the blueprint. Blame the blueprint!
The battery is dead and it was your shift!
A hatch chewed the wire. Take it up with the hatch!
You left the airlock open on purpose so I would yell about it.
And yet. Here you are. Yelling.
You have been 'inspecting' that ladder for an hour.
Inspection is work. Ask anyone who isn't you.
Your tunnel is genius. Visionary. Historic.
It's a hole. You want my rations, don't you?
How's my new great hall?
Mid.
MID? There's a water fountain!

crybaby.text: Why are you yelling at me... waaah—
Don't cry! I'm not yelling anymore, see!
I'm not losing this argument, I'm just... having emotions.
Wipe your eyes first. We'll restart the fight.
The whole colony bullies me! Now you too!
I don't! ...This is a lot of pressure, honestly.
Stop being mean! My tears don't have a valve!
Okay okay, I'm sorry, here's a tissue!

gentle.text: I don't want to fight... but you really did this one wrong.
Just yell at me once. This calm thing hurts worse.
Can we argue sitting down? Standing feels too hostile.
Lower your voice. You're scaring the hatch.
The hatch?! Now of all times?!
I won't fight you. But I'm writing this down. Gently.

hothead.text: I'm faster than anyone at this! Got a problem?!
Fast, yes. You also broke the wall!
Fine, blame me! Blame me for the whole base!
Nobody said— there you go again.
Three counts. Give back my shovel. One! Two!!
What happened to three? — Oh. You already grabbed it.
I'm not angry! This is just my voice!!
The ceiling regolith disagrees.

base.text: Honestly, without you in this dump I'd have cracked long ago.
Same here. Best partners ever.
First thing after we get out: I'm buying you real water.
Ha, I'll hold you to that.
You're the only one who knows where my berry stash is.
That's a life-debt level of trust.
If I go first, you get my cot.
Don't jinx it. ...It is the good spot, though.
Complaining to you makes the work feel lighter.
Come back anytime. Unlimited grumbling, no charge.
You have walked beside me for three corridors and said nothing.
I know. It's the best part of my shift.
You're my emotional support duplicant.
And you're mine. The colony should list us as infrastructure.
...You hit harder than you look.
So do you. Help me up.
Had enough?
Enough. Honestly? You can take more than I figured.
My nose is still bleeding.
I can't open one eye. ...Come on, let's get patched up.
All that over something that small. Worth it?
No. But I feel a lot better.
Next time just say it instead of sitting on it.
Deal. I've paid enough for sitting on it today.
That was three people's rations.
I'm counting. Don't.
Leave some for night shift.
Night shift will understand.
You're not even chewing.
Chewing takes time.
The fridge is empty.
Good. Empty I understand.
You're going to regret that.
That's a problem for later me.
I'll sit here. You don't have to talk.
...Okay.
I had one too. Two cycles back.
You didn't let anyone see.
Everyone else left.
You didn't.
Want some water.
Yeah.
We'll head back when you're ready.
That could be a while.
I won't tell anyone.
You will. But thanks.
How long has he been crying.
...Don't look at me.
Want me to get someone?
Doesn't matter who.
Everyone stopped what they were doing.
That's why I can't stop.
Anything I say right now is useless.
Then don't say it.
Oxygen's fine. Water's fine.
Then what am I crying about.
I fixed that yesterday.
You fixed it well. It rang for ages.
Stop—that's the oxygen unit.
...Which one.
You're smashing our stuff.
What in here is mine?
Are you done.
No. But my hand hurts.
The wall is harder than you are.
The wall has never let me down.
Don't touch him.
Stay back. I can't hold it.
The wiring's arcing.
I know. It's me.
He took out the whole light bank.
Saving power.
You'll hurt yourself doing that.
Already am.
The machines are scared of you.
The machines are smart.
I just mopped that.
I know. Sorry.
Somebody get a bucket.
Too late.
That's not food poisoning, is it.
No.
Don't all stand around watching.
They're not watching me. They're watching the floor.
You should eat something after.
Seriously?
The whole corridor can hear that.
Good.
He isn't screaming at us.
I know you're all there.
Should I shut the door.
I'd still be inside it.
I've heard that pitch down in the mines.
At least the mines echo back.
Does screaming help.
No. Not screaming is worse.
Maybe... we should call it off.
No hard feelings. Take care.
We can fix any pipe on this base. Not this.
...Yeah. At least the pipes are fine.
I'll take the east tables. You take the west.
Okay. ...Take care of yourself.
Here's your oxygen canister back. All of it.
Keep it. Call it... a gift from a friend.
Hold still. Let me redo that bandage.
Easy... but thank you.
Rest today. We will handle the remaining work.
Hearing that, I can finally close my eyes.
The medicine is bitter, so here's half a candied berry.
Half? ...Fine. Nurse's orders.
Fever's gone, but you're staying down today.
This cot is fusing to my back. ...Okay, you win.
I checked the germ overlay. Your bedside is spotless.
Great, I can cough freely. ...Kidding.
I measured the dose myself. Drink up.
Who poured a double last time, again?
...Which is why I weighed it three times.
You haul like a champion.
Thanks. My back has filed a formal complaint.
The printing pod lit up by itself last night.
It's deciding who to print next. Don't interrupt.
I climb so many ladders I climb them in my dreams.
At least dream ladders don't come with a hauling errand.
What will you do when the colony is finished?
Sleep without an alarm clock.
A hatch ate my spare boots again.
It eats better than we do. Let that sink in.
Do you smell something weird?
Narrow it down. This base is a bouquet.
The printing pod has new picks tomorrow.
Please be someone who can wire a battery.
I dug three tons of granite yesterday. I counted.
Stop counting. The number only ever goes up.
That pacu doesn't look stressed at all.
It never has to read the schedule.
All the carbon dioxide sinks to the bottom floor.
That's why top bunks are a survival strategy.
Did you understand the new painting?
No. But the decor number went up, so I nodded.
My atmo suit smell has developed layers.
That's the smell of seniority.
Meteor shower tonight. Don't look up.
Don't worry. The regolith will remember for us.
You said 'nice weather in the base' yesterday. Word for word.
I have four thoughts. I rotate them.
You know what you need? To go outside and touch some grass.
We are four hundred meters underground. I'll touch the algae.
The far wall is on fire and you are still eating.
It's contained. Mostly. This is fine.
The ladder broke and I fell two floors.
Skill issue. ...You okay, though?
Reactor's overheating and the farm is flooded.
We're so cooked.
Literally, if that reactor blows.
You are eating over the compost in an unwashed suit.
The suit and I have an arrangement. Don't get involved.
I dug the same corridor so long I forgot my own name.
It's on your suit.
...Huh. So it is.
Why do you always dig the front tunnel?
Someone has to be the one the story follows.
The story is about oxygen.
What the hatch doin'?
Head first into the granite. Third time this shift.
That pacu has been circling the same pond all night.
Oiia, oiia.
Stop narrating. Help me with the filter.
The airlock cycled eight hundred times today.
Hardest worker in the colony. Give it the raise.
I labeled every pipe in the base.
Wonderful. The next flood will be beautifully documented.

crybaby.text: I read today's schedule and... I might cry a little.
Don't cry, don't cry. I'll take your latrine shift.
That hatch looked at me so gently...
It wants your boots. Don't get attached.
I'm not crying. It's the CO2.
Sure. The CO2. Tissues are in locker two.
Do you think the printing pod ever gets sad...
Keep going and I'll be the one crying.

eater.text: Think a mush bar would taste better toasted?
Last time you toasted one, the mess hall blew a fuse.
I'm not hungry. I'm eating preventively.
You've preventively eaten tomorrow's ration too.
What are we talking about? ...Is there food?
Three sentences in and you're back to food.
Night shift bonus should be fried mush bars.
You already wrote yourself into the schedule as taste-tester.

hothead.text: Move, move, I'll do it myself! — Not yelling at you. Yelling near you.
Noted. Observing the champion from a safe distance.
Who designed these ladders? Third climb today!
Someone who never climbs. Keep it down, the regolith is shaking.
If the pod doesn't print help soon, I'm knocking on it myself.
Knock away. It'll print someone exactly as patient as you.
Blocked tunnel? Step aside. Two minutes.
All yours. I'll go fetch the spare shovel.

loud.text: I'm not shouting! This is my normal volume!
The hatches evacuated. That's your normal volume.
EVERYONE LISTEN— hey, why the earplugs?
Go ahead. We're listening with our eyes.
Learned a new song! Let me belt it!
Take it to the airlock. Both doors, please.

nervous.text: D-did you hear that? There's something in the pipes.
That's water. Probably. ...Probably!
I counted the oxygen three times. It checks out. I still don't feel okay.
I'll sit with you for the fourth count.
What if a meteor punches through tonight??
Then it hits my shift and you get the night off.
Don't sneak up on me, I drop live wires.
Got it, I'll knock next time. On the wall. We have no doors.

base.text: You don't have to talk. I'll just sit here.
...Thanks. The fans sound quieter today.
I covered your shift. Go rest a while.
That's what they always said too... thank you.
I brought two meals. We can just chew if talking's too much.
...Chewing does quiet the thinking. A little.
I'm in the next cot tonight. Knock the wall if you can't sleep.
...Okay. I might knock.
We split the work they left unfinished. You take your time.
...Thanks. I just... need company being slow.
One day I'll build you a small room. A lamp. One plant that isn't food.
...Put me in that room. I'll allow the plant.
Honestly... every shift I'm paired with you, I secretly smile.
Silly. Me too.
This rock is terrifying, but not when you're near.
Then... let's stay near.
When the power died that night, my first thought was you.
...I crossed half the base in the dark to find you.
Half of my oxygen canister is yours. Always.
Dummy. Then we'd have to stay together forever.
That's the idea.
The decor is negative and the food is grim.
And?
And you smile, and none of it matters.
I dug for nine hours thinking about your stupid pipe layout.
Nine hours. And I never paid you any rent.
I... I've liked you for a long time...
Oh... I'm sorry. I need to focus on surviving right now.
...Forget I said anything.
So... I might, sort of, like you.
You're one of the good ones. My heart's just full elsewhere.
Understood. Friends as usual?
I like you. Took me ten cycles to say it.
Thank you for telling me. I can't answer the same way.
It's fine. Saying it was worth it.
I always look forward to pipe duty with you.
To me you're my best workmate... I'm sorry.
Workmate's still good. Plenty of pipes left.
He smiled at me near the printing pod.
He was smiling at the pod. It makes new coworkers.
...Let me have this for one more cycle.
Being apart taught me arguing beats missing you.
Then argue properly this time. And stay.
I fixed the wrench you left behind. Here.
You dope. I left it on purpose.
The west tables are too quiet. Can I come back?
...Your seat's been waiting this whole time.
Let's overhaul the old problems, like servicing pipes.
By the blueprint this time. I already drew it.
There were things I never said. Now I never can.
I never even asked which ration you liked best.
I used to blame the schedule for keeping us apart. Can't blame it this time.
Just us two today. Nowhere else to be.
Deal. A rare moment to ourselves.
Later, let's go stargazing?
With you here, even the vents sound like music.
Flatterer. ...I feel it too, though.
I traded away today's shift a week in advance.
I traded mine two weeks ago.
...That's why it's you.
One bristle blossom. It's all I could requisition.
It's plenty. Plus five decor, plus everything else.
I booked the arcade cabinet. One whole cycle.
Then what are we waiting for? See you on the high score board.
No oxygen talk, no power talk, no pipe talk today.
Then what do we talk about?
You.
You name every hatch you fight.
I need to know who I'm losing to.
And that's why it's you.
So are we together, or just... adjacent?
Adjacent has fewer forms to file.
...Then let's file the forms.
Enough. Don't talk to me for a while.
Gladly. And don't sit next to me at meals.
Let's just cool off for a while.
Fine. The pipes are your problem now.
I left your tools on your locker.
Fine. We'll use our own from now on.
So that's what you really thought of me.
...Likewise. Let's leave it there.
Food arrived. Nobody mentions what they were thinking a few days ago.
The pantry is stocked again. By silent agreement, the subject is closed.
Stay back.
Only one of us walks away from this.
I don't want to do this.
Neither do I. But I'm hungry.
I'm sorry.
Don't apologise. Just do it.
Why us?
Because nobody likes either of us.
One left. The base is very quiet now, and there is plenty to eat.
There is food again. Nobody asks what it is.
The crisis is over. People sit a little further apart than they used to.
The larder is full again. Nobody checked the label.
The pantry is empty. Nobody is talking, but everybody is counting heads.
Three days without food. Today, people started looking at each other differently.
The last ration is gone. What gets shared out next, nobody will say out loud.
Sixty degrees. How did you hold out?
I didn't. I was thinking about popsicles.
My legs went when I came out.
Mine too. Don't tell anyone.
Was that noise you or the pipe?
...The pipe.
Don't take the visor off that early next time.
I thought we were out.
Are we the joke on that roster?
Yes. And we're still standing.
You went down yesterday too.
It was my turn.
Do you swear when the visor fogs up?
Yes. Badly.
That level isn't so bad actually.
It is that bad.
Forget it.
...Yeah.
Next time we go together. It's faster.
Fine.
You went down again.
I've got better lungs.
That level's mine next time.
You've said that three times.
I owe you.
Just remember it.
You don't have to keep going in my place.
What, and watch you go?
Thanks.
Don't.
The chlorine level. That's been me all month.
I don't write the roster.
Do you even know what it smells like down there.
I counted. Forty cycles.
Why would you count that.
When did you last go down.
I have things to do up here.
It's not that I'm scared. It's that it's always me.
Then take it up with the roster.
I saw you two. Having a lovely chat, were we?
It's not what you think!
I see. I'm on the schedule, but someone's in your heart.
Let me explain...
Does wire repair really require standing that close?
That's standard operating distance!
I... hear a pipe leaking somewhere. Bye.
A whole shift away, and I come back to this.
We were literally just counting hatches!
You laughed at their airlock joke. You never laugh at mine.
Theirs was about a DIFFERENT airlock.
I'll just... see myself out.
Your name is still on the schedule... I cannot erase it yet.
We were supposed to see the colony finished together. Why did you leave first?
I cleaned your atmo suit and hung it in the usual spot. As if you might come back for it.
The oxygen is rich today and dinner was almost good. Of all the days for you to miss.
Everyone over here! No work talk tonight!
Then what do I talk about? Tomorrow's shifts?
Hahaha!
Cheers to surviving another cycle!
Cheers — with recycled water.
Next time, filtered water!
Tonight's music: the manual generator!
That's just someone doing overtime.
Keep the tempo steady!
Everyone share their worst day here.
Me first: I fell into the polluted water tank.
You win. Instantly.
A toast! To the ceiling that hasn't collapsed!
To everyone still breathing!
To whoever's off early shift — no one? Party's over.
Who brought the harmonica?
No harmonica. Just the gas vents.
Close enough. Very rock and roll.
You're at the party but facing the wall.
I'm here in spirit. The wall and I are close.
One drink. The wall will wait.
Vibe check: how are we all doing?
Alive.
Employed. ...Passing grade, barely.
New rule: tonight's dance contest has no rules.
Then how do we win?
Nobody knows. We're a room full of huh-cats.
There's a green blob vibing by the jukebot.
That's a morb. How did it get in here?
It glorped in. It stays for one song.
The food tastes worse after days of silence.
...I'm sorry. I overreacted.
Truce. Talk to me next time.
You covered my shift yesterday. I know it was you.
...Hmph. It was on my way.
On your way. So is making up. Come on.
Even the hatches avoid us lately.
We've been that scary, huh. ...I'll go first: I'm sorry.
Accepted. Let's go eat.
Here. Espresso. I queued half an hour for the machine.
This is bribery. ...I accept.
I've got your number now.
Likewise. Stay out of my sight.
This isn't a fight anymore. This is a grudge.
Then hold it. I'll hold mine longer.
You and me? We're done.
We were done a long time ago.
One base. We're going to keep running into each other.
And every time, I'll enjoy ruining your day.
I don't care what the others think of you. I can't stand you.
Good. I wasn't aiming to be liked.
I heard. ...I'm not sad, and nobody gets to make me fake it.
I was saving up a win for the next time we met. Guess I'll keep it.
Don't look at me like that. I'm not smiling. It's just a good day.
One less mouth breathing my oxygen. Works for me.
I'll go clear out that locker. Tired of looking at it.
Is this seat taken?
It is now. Sit down, I saved the least burnt piece.
The mush bar is almost soft today.
Don't celebrate. It might just be damp.
Eating alone is too quiet.
Perfect timing. I have a whole shift's worth of complaints.
Today's liceloaf is extra... structural.
Chef calls it texture. I call it jaw day.
My dessert for your wall seat.
Deal. Friend price: half the dessert.
Slow down, nobody is stealing your plate.
You don't get it. Chew fast and you can't taste it.
They say table talk aids digestion.
Then this meal needs a very long conversation.
A wash basin in the mess hall. Fancy.
Fewer germs, same amount of complaining.
What's the scientific name for this?
The menu just says 'surprise'.
Should we stop him? That's the third bristle berry on the grill.
No. Let him cook. Literally, for once.
Three berries and a pickled meal lice. That's dinner?
It's a curated plate. Don't look at it too long.
Half of every meal you cook goes missing.
Kitchen tax. The chef eats first. That's civilization.
They swapped the barbeque for mush bars.
I'm eating it and crying. Full banana cat.
That's your third helping tonight.
The chonk chart doesn't judge me. Neither should you.
Your technique is off. Watch me once.
So that's it! No wonder I'm always a step slow.
There's a trick to this job. Let me show you.
Noted! I owe you a soft mush bar.
Don't fight the pick. Let it fall on its own.
Oh! And the saved energy goes to dinner.
Before touching a wire, tap it with the back of your hand.
Why the back?
So the shock throws your hand clear. Remember it.
Save your research data before you click around.
So that's how last week's report died... noted.
Don't vent the whole room to kill the germs. You are also in the room.
...That explains the last report ending mid-sentence.
I asked for one ladder. You built a stairwell with lighting.
You said 'access.' I heard 'dignity.'
I can't take it anymore, there are pipes to fix everywhere...
Breathe. Pipes are infinite; you are not.
...Thanks. Saying it out loud helps.
Dreamed the power grid died again. My hands are still shaking.
Just a dream. Come sit with me a while.
Yeah. Glad you're here.
The electrolyzer blew again. Everyone's oxygen is on me...
Sit down. Oxygen has reserves. You don't have a backup.
...Okay. Breathing first.
A full shift on the hamster wheel. My legs won't stop.
I'll take tomorrow. The wheel can't bully both of us.
...Deal. You're a good one.
The meteors keep hammering. I can't sleep.
They won't get through. I checked every tile myself.
...Somehow that actually helps.
What if I wake up and the oxygen reads zero?
You'd wake up next to me first. Panic later.
Ha... fair.
I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm fine.
That's four this cycle. Sit. I'll take the next shift.
...One more: I'm fine. Okay. Sitting.
I am one broken pipe away from crashing out entirely.
Then I'll fix the pipe. Sit down.
...Okay. Watching you fix it helps.
What are you thinking about?
Nothing. Beautifully, completely nothing.
Finally, someone at peace in this colony.
How often do you think about that one flooded shaft?
Daily. Sometimes twice, if the pump hums wrong.
...It haunts me too. Cycle 12. Never again.
Two straight shifts on the manual generator.
Sad hamster hours. Tiniest violin. I'm taking the next one.
...Okay. You win.

crybaby.text: I can't hold it in... the mush bars are gone again...
Cry it out. Half of mine tomorrow is yours.
Snff... you're the best...
I dreamed the printing pod didn't want me anymore...
Dreams lie. Who else would it even print?
R-really...? Okay...
My tears fell into the regolith. Will something grow...?
You'll be the first to know. Here, wipe up.
...Ha. Now I'm laughing and crying.
I'm not fragile. I just have surplus water draining through my eyes.
Drain away. Drainage is honest work.
...Mm! Feeling better already.

hothead.text: I nearly took the hamster wheel apart today! It spins too slow!!
Breathe before dismantling. The wheel is public property.
...Hooo. Fine. It lives. For now.
Why do I get every busted pipe?!
Because you're fastest. That's a compliment, stop glaring.
...Fine. That reason I accept.
I'm counting to three, and if this base blacks out again—
At three we go crank the generator together.
...Deal. One, two... move.
I'm not angry! I'm just too efficient to sit still!
Then lend me half that energy for hauling.
...Take it, take it. Feels better out loud.

nervous.text: I keep thinking the backup battery isn't full. It is full. I checked...
Then we check once more. Together.
...That was the seventh check. Thanks for coming.
What if? What if the oxygen, while I'm asleep—
Stop. The alarm works nights. You work days. Clear division of labor.
...Fine. I'll only wake up three times.
The pipe made a noise! You heard it, right?!
Heard it. Thermal expansion. I signed its health certificate.
...You made that up. It helped anyway.
My heart is racing. Is the base about to blow?
That's from three ladder sprints. Sit. Sip water.
...Oh. Right. Okay, settling down now.

base.text: Hi everyone, I just stepped out of the printer...
Welcome to the family! Go claim a seat in the mess hall.
It's... livelier than the brochure said.
That's the spirit. Ask us anything.
It felt warmer inside the printing pod...
Too late to climb back in. Here's your shovel.
Quick question: which way to the lavatory?
Excellent question. That's the most important knowledge here.
I have three skills. Here's my resume.
Breathing is the only requirement. We'll teach the rest.
I was printed today and I already have a schedule.
Welcome. It gets worse, and then you get used to it.
Hi! I'm new and I already love it here!
Happy cat energy. Ask me again in three cycles.
Do I get a locker?
You get a cot and a dream. Lockers unlock at level two.
Somebody has to answer for this.
...Why is it me.
I'm not saying he did it. I'm saying I didn't.
You already said it.
The report needs a name on it.
So you picked the easiest one to write.
Everyone here knows.
Knowing isn't proof.
You were there that shift, weren't you.
I was asleep. Everyone's always there. It's one base.
Somebody used my name today.
...They should have all along.
You're not angry anymore?
Tired of it.
Nobody's brought up last month in a while.
Then let's not bring it up.
I thought I'd be that guy forever.
Next time it'll be somebody else.
The roster put me back on days.
...I did that.
This table's full.
...You're the only one at it.
Don't talk to me. I'd rather not catch it.
Neither would I.

Use the other side.
The other side is a wall.
Who's pairing with him? ...Fine. Nobody, then.
I can finish it alone.
Nobody down here.
—What are you doing!
Don't shout. Nobody's coming anyway.
...I know.
That one's for last week.
Last week I was in a med bed.
Clean up before you go out. Don't let them see.
You don't let them see either.
It isn't personal. This place needs somewhere to vent.
Then go find a wall.
I'm sitting here. Nothing else to it.
...Nobody's sat here in days.
I brought two portions.
Aren't you worried who sees?
Who gave you that.
...I fell.
I don't care what they're saying. You still owe me a night shift.
...I know I do.
Finish crying, then eat. It's worse cold.
...Yeah.
What are you doing down here.
...Nothing. Dust in my eye.
No cameras on this level. No one either. Finish.
I'm already finished.
Want me to go?
...No. Just stand there.
I didn't see anything.
Thank you.
I thought this level was empty.
So did I.
I pulled the logs. He was on the far side that shift.
...You actually pulled the logs?
Blame me. I wrote the roster.
You don't have to do that for me.
What we're short on is a working machine, not someone to yell at.
...Thank you.
My word still counts around here. He didn't do it.
I thought everyone had stopped remembering me.
Next time somebody wants a name, they come to me first.
...Then you'd better watch yourself.
I saw that.
You saw what.
Put your hand down.
...None of your business.
So you check for witnesses first. Good to know.
Shut up.
I'm going to remember today.
Suit yourself.
I was in the vent while you were doing it.
...Then you heard more than you saw.

ordinary: How many tons of granite did you dig today?
Don't ask. My back filed a complaint.
The mush bar got even harder today.
At least it's warm... okay, it's not.

At least you didn't sleepwalk into the oxygen diffuser.
The air feels thinner today.
Breathe slowly. Call it cardio.

I stress-eat. Can't smash anything on a full stomach.

And it printed five kilos of clay, didn't it.

Don't look at me. I clog, I don't fix.

It likes you. Well, it likes your carbon dioxide.

Tell me a bedtime story?

It is what it is.

I'm not slacking. I'm delivering exactly forty kilograms of effort.
That is the job description, yes.

GG. Go next. ...What do you mean it's our only base?

Womp womp. ...Sorry, I meant: there, there.

Cat distribution system. It chose you. Congratulations.
breaking: Don't talk to me yet... I need a second to breathe.
Okay. I'm right here. Not talking.
The alarm in my head is louder than the base's.
Then switch one off: sit down, drink some water.
